content: {"paper_id":"W2951821459","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"partial-label-learning","exact_quote":"Partial label learning aims to induce a multi-class classifier from training examples where each of them is associated with a set of candidate labels, among which only one is the ground-truth label.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确以偏标记学习为研究任务，样本带候选标签集合且仅一个为真标签。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"each of them is associated with a set of candidate labels, among which only one is the ground-truth label","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"候选标签集合仅一个真值，属于候选歧义的不精确监督，且作为核心学习条件。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","exact_quote":"jointly optimizes the ground-truth labeling confidences, similarity graph and model parameters","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"方法将相似度图与标签置信度、模型参数联合优化，显式学习样本间亲和图结构。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","exact_quote":"adaptive graph could be more robust and accurate to reveal the intrinsic manifold structure within the data","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"自适应图用于揭示数据内在流形结构并引导标签消歧，对标签置信度施加几何一致性约束。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
